Stripe

Connect payment events with clear product access and records.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Stripe provides APIs and hosted experiences for payments and billing. We can integrate a checkout or subscription flow with a SaaS product, then map payment events into the application's access rules and operational records. The implementation covers successful payments and the less visible states, including failed renewals, cancellation, refunds, and events arriving more than once.

Useful outputs

  • Checkout or subscription integration
  • Verified event handling and account state rules
  • Billing support and reconciliation workflow

Where we can apply it

  • SaaS purchase: checkout → verified payment event → product entitlement.
  • Renewal management: invoice event → status update → customer notification.
  • Finance review: payment records → reconciliation check → exception queue.
01

Use case 1

Create checkout journeys for supported products and business models.

02

Use case 2

Connect subscriptions and billing states to customer account entitlements.

03

Use case 3

Build finance-facing views of payment events and reconciliation exceptions.

Inputs we need

  • Approved products, prices, and billing rules
  • Business account eligibility and payment requirements
  • Entitlement states and webhook event contracts

Delivery sequence

  • Define the product, billing model, and account access transitions.
  • Implement checkout and verified, idempotent webhook processing.
  • Check failures, duplicate events, cancellations, and support operations in test mode.

Expert review points

  • Review business availability and supported payment methods.
  • Confirm payment events cannot grant incorrect account access.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
